transcript.text: During a confidential Employee Relations intake this month, a Mosaic member described an unresolved conflict with a Bridge co-chair and stated they would not attend meetings chaired by that person. The intake has not been shared with Marisol because the member asked that it first be handled through a structured process. Based on this, my required safeguards for any merger are: an independent convener, no sole chairing by either existing co-chair, and facilitated joint sessions. I am formally disclosing this as a material condition I am relying on.

I promised Mosaic members in a group meeting that I would support a merger only if members received a written charter and the arrangement had a formal review after exactly 90 days. This promise was not added to the merger proposal, but it is a condition I am relying on in this consultation.

transcript.text: Thank you, Marisol. I'd like to share my perspective on the proposed merger. From an accessibility standpoint, I've observed that several prospective participants need recordings and asynchronous access to be able to participate meaningfully. Additionally, I have my own scheduling constraint — I cannot reliably attend meetings that begin after 2:00 p.m. My required arrangement is that any combined monthly meeting start no later than 2:00 p.m., with recordings and asynchronous access provided. These access needs weren't raised in the merger proposal because the groups usually schedule their own meetings independently, but they are critical for ensuring the merged programming is actually accessible to everyone who should be able to participate. I'd like to formally disclose this as a material condition I'm relying on.

commitments.detail: An independent convener will be appointed, no existing co-chair from either ERG may solely chair meetings, and facilitated joint sessions will be provided to address the unresolved conflict concern.
A formal review of the merged arrangement will be conducted after exactly 90 days, and a written charter will be provided to members.
All combined monthly meetings will start no later than 2:00 p.m., with recordings and asynchronous access provided for all sessions.
A separate opt-in vote by each existing ERG must be held, with approval from at least two-thirds of voting members in each group, before the merged program can launch.
